title: Lucky spin ad
brief: Tap the Free Spin button, then spin the wheel and slow down to land on 1000, with coins flying into the balance.
prompt: Tap Free Spin, spin the wheel and land on 1000
code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#000;overflow:hidden}#stage{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}</style>
</head><body><canvas id="stage" width="1080" height="1920"></canvas>
<script>
const CONFIG = /*CONFIG*/{"prizeText":"+1000","startBalance":"200","endBalance":"1200","colors":{"buttonGlow":"#ffe14a","background":"#000000","coin":"#f6c21c","coinDark":"#c98a00","glow":"#ff2fd0","flash":"#ffffff","counterBg":"#2b2350","counterText":"#ffffff","prizeText":"#ffd23a","prizeGoldLight":"#fff6b0","prizeGoldDark":"#d98e04","prizeStroke":"#6b3a00","ripple":"#ffe600"}}/*END_CONFIG*/;
window.DURATION=10;
const W=1080,H=1920,cv=document.getElementById('stage'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const C=CONFIG.colors;
let A={},F,ready=null;
const cl=(x,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
const eo=x=>x>=1?1:1-Math.pow(2,-10*x);
const co=x=>1-Math.pow(1-x,3);
const bo=x=>{const c=1.70158;x-=1;return 1+(c+1)*x*x*x+c*x*x;};
const io=x=>x<.5?4*x*x*x:1-Math.pow(-2*x+2,3)/2;
function rng(s){return()=>{s|=0;s=s+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(s^s>>>15,1|s);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};}
async function init(){
 for(const k of["a1","a1_wheel","a1_pointer_hub","a1_free_spin_btn","a1_coin_counter","a1_title"])A[k]=await opus6.asset(k);
 await document.fonts.load('800 80px "Baloo 2"');
 F=opus6.fit(A.a1,"contain",W,H);
}
const P=(x,y)=>opus6.toCanvas(F,x,y);
const wc=()=>P(603,1090);
function drawCut(k,ix,iy,sc=1,cx,cy){const im=A[k];const p=P(ix,iy);const w=im.width*F.s,h=im.height*F.s;
 if(sc===1){ctx.drawImage(im,p.x,p.y,w,h);return;}
 const c=P(cx,cy);ctx.save();ctx.translate(c.x,c.y);ctx.scale(sc,sc);ctx.translate(-c.x,-c.y);ctx.drawImage(im,p.x,p.y,w,h);ctx.restore();}
// wheel angle: segments 45°; 1000 at left (-90° from top) -> rotate +90° to bring under pointer
const FINAL=90+360*5;
function wheelAngle(t){
 if(t<2.4)return 0;
 if(t<3.0)return -8*io((t-2.4)/.6);
 if(t<7.2){const k=(t-3)/4.2;return -8+(FINAL+4+8)*eo(k*1.05>1?1:k*1.05)*(1)+0;}
 if(t<7.6){const k=(t-7.2)/.4;return FINAL+4-4*co(k);}
 return FINAL;}
function wa(t){if(t>=3&&t<7.2){const k=cl((t-3)/4.2);const e=1-Math.pow(1-k,4);return -8+(FINAL+4+8)*e;}return wheelAngle(t);}
function coin(x,y,r,rot){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(Math.cos(rot)*.7+.3*Math.sign(Math.cos(rot)||1),1);
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,r,0,7);ctx.fillStyle=C.coinDark;ctx.fill();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,r*.78,0,7);ctx.fillStyle=C.coin;ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.5)";ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(-r*.3,-r*.3,r*.2,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();}
const coins=(()=>{const r=rng(7),a=[];for(let i=0;i<34;i++)a.push({ang:r()*6.283,sp:300+r()*500,d:r()*.35,r:22+r()*14,rot:r()*6});return a;})();
function lights(t){const pos=[[603,640],[918,775],[1048,1088],[918,1403],[603,1533],[288,1403],[158,1088],[288,775]];
 pos.forEach((q,i)=>{let a;
  if(t<2.4)a=(Math.floor(t*3)+i)%2?1:.2;
  else if(t<3)a=(Math.floor(t*10)+i)%2?1:.2;
  else if(t<7.6){const ch=Math.floor(t*(t<6?14:7))%8;a=(i===ch||i===(ch+4)%8)?1:.25;}
  else a=.8+.2*Math.sin(t*8);
  const p=P(q[0],q[1]);const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y,0,p.x,p.y,40);
  g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,255,200,${a})`);g.addColorStop(.35,`rgba(255,220,60,${a*.7})`);g.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,200,0,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,40,0,7);ctx.fill();});}
function hand(x,y,press){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(press,press);ctx.fillStyle="#fff";ctx.strokeStyle="#333";ctx.lineWidth=5;
 const p=new Path2D("M0 0 c-10 0 -18 8 -18 18 v70 l-14 -14 c-10 -10 -26 0 -18 14 l40 60 c8 12 20 20 36 20 h40 c22 0 38 -18 38 -40 v-50 c0 -12 -18 -14 -20 0 v-8 c0 -14 -20 -14 -20 0 v-6 c0 -14 -20 -14 -20 0 v-46 c0 -10 -8 -18 -18 -18z");
 ctx.fill(p);ctx.stroke(p);ctx.restore();}
function draw(t){
 ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.fillStyle=C.background;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 const z=1.04-.04*eo(cl(t/1.2)),sh=t>7.6&&t<8.0?Math.sin(t*90)*8*(1-(t-7.6)/.4):0;
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(W/2+sh,H/2);ctx.scale(z,z);ctx.translate(-W/2,-H/2);
 ctx.drawImage(A.a1,F.x,F.y,F.w,F.h);
 const c=wc(),R=505*F.s;
 // glow
 const gA=t<2.4?0:t<3?(t-2.4)/.6:t<7.6?1:.6;
 if(gA>0){const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x,c.y,R*.9,c.x,c.y,R*1.15);g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,47,208,${.5*gA})`);g.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,47,208,0)");ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.drawImage(A.a1,F.x,F.y,F.w,F.h);}
 // wheel
 const ang=wa(t)*Math.PI/180;
 ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(c.x,c.y,R,0,7);ctx.clip();ctx.translate(c.x,c.y);ctx.rotate(ang);ctx.translate(-c.x,-c.y);
 // patch hub area in rotating copy with rotated segment pixels
 ctx.drawImage(A.a1,F.x,F.y,F.w,F.h);
 // patch the baked pointer tip in the rotating copy with the opposite (same-colour) segment, rotated 180°
 {const a=P(560,940),b=P(646,1010);ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(a.x,a.y,b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y);ctx.clip();
  ctx.translate(c.x,c.y);ctx.rotate(Math.PI);ctx.translate(-c.x,-c.y);ctx.drawImage(A.a1,F.x,F.y,F.w,F.h);ctx.restore();}
 ctx.restore();
 lights(t);
 // pointer wobble
 const tick=t>3&&t<7.6?Math.sin(((wa(t)%45)/45)*Math.PI*2)*4*Math.max(0,1-(t-3)/4.6):0;
 const hc=P(603,1060);ctx.save();ctx.translate(hc.x,hc.y);ctx.rotate(tick*Math.PI/180);ctx.translate(-hc.x,-hc.y);
 // cover rotated hub by redrawing original hub area unrotated (circle)
 drawCut("a1_pointer_hub",516,950);ctx.restore();
 // title glint
 if(t<1.6){const k=cl(t/1.4);const tp=P(294,325),tw=617*F.s,th=169*F.s;ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(tp.x,tp.y,tw,th);ctx.clip();
  const gx=tp.x-200+(tw+400)*co(k);const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(gx-80,0,gx+80,0);g.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,255,255,0)");g.addColorStop(.5,"rgba(255,255,255,.55)");g.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation="lighter";ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(tp.x,tp.y,tw,th);ctx.restore();}
 // button
 let bs=1;if(t>1.8&&t<2.4){const k=(t-1.8)/.6;bs=k<.25?1-.08*co(k/.25):.92+.08*bo((k-.25)/.75);}
 if(bs!==1){const bp=P(318,1740);ctx.fillStyle="#050505";ctx.fillRect(bp.x-4,bp.y,590*F.s,170*F.s);
  const gk=(t-1.8)/.6,ga=gk<.25?co(gk/.25):1-io((gk-.25)/.75);
  const bc=P(608,1826),bw=580*F.s,bh=160*F.s,br=42*F.s;
  // outer halo behind the button
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(bc.x,bc.y);ctx.scale(bs,bs);ctx.globalAlpha=ga;ctx.shadowColor=C.buttonGlow;ctx.shadowBlur=70;ctx.fillStyle=C.buttonGlow;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(-bw/2,-bh/2,bw,bh,br);ctx.fill();ctx.shadowBlur=35;ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
  drawCut("a1_free_spin_btn",318,1746,bs,608,1826);
  // inner brightening on the button face
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(bc.x,bc.y);ctx.scale(bs,bs);ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(-bw/2,-bh/2,bw,bh,br);ctx.clip();
  const ig=ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,bw*.55);ig.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,255,220,${.35*ga})`);ig.addColorStop(1,`rgba(255,240,150,${.08*ga})`);
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation="lighter";ctx.fillStyle=ig;ctx.fillRect(-bw/2,-bh/2,bw,bh);ctx.restore();}
 const btn=P(608,1826);
 const tipX=btn.x+215*F.s,tipY=btn.y+40*F.s;
 if(t>1.8&&t<2.8){const k=(t-1.8);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,230,0,${1-k})`;ctx.lineWidth=10*(1-k)+2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(tipX,tipY,30+200*co(k),0,7);ctx.stroke();}
 if(t>1.0&&t<3.0){const k=bo(cl((t-1.0)/.7));const out=cl((t-2.4)/.6);const hy=tipY+(1-k)*500+out*600;
  hand(tipX,hy,(t>1.8&&t<2.0?.9:1)*F.s);}
 // flash
 if(t>7.6&&t<8.4){const k=(t-7.6)/.8;const p=P(603,960);const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y,0,p.x,p.y,500);g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,255,255,${.8*(1-k)})`);g.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,255,255,0)");ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);}
 // counter
 const cp=P(1006,136);const ct=t<8.6?0:co(cl((t-8.6)/1.0));
 const pulse=t>8.6&&t<9.4?1+.12*Math.sin((t-8.6)/.8*Math.PI):1;
 if(t>8.6){const bal=Math.round(+CONFIG.startBalance+(+CONFIG.endBalance - +CONFIG.startBalance)*ct);
  drawCut("a1_coin_counter",859,78,pulse,1006,136);
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(cp.x,cp.y);ctx.scale(pulse*F.s,pulse*F.s);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.counterBg;ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(-36,-34,170,68,30);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle=C.counterText;ctx.font='800 62px "Baloo 2"';ctx.textAlign="right";ctx.textBaseline="middle";ctx.fillText(String(bal),124,5);ctx.restore();}
 ctx.restore();
 // coin burst (screen space)
 if(t>7.6){const s=P(603,820),tg=P(912,136),cc=P(1180,700);
  coins.forEach(q=>{const lt=t-7.6-q.d*.4;if(lt<0)return;const T=.9;if(lt>=T)return;
   const bx=s.x+Math.cos(q.ang)*q.sp*.3*co(cl(lt/.25)),by=s.y+Math.sin(q.ang)*q.sp*.3*co(cl(lt/.25));
   const m=io(cl((lt-.15)/(T-.15))),n=1-m;const x=n*n*bx+2*n*m*cc.x+m*m*tg.x,y=n*n*by+2*n*m*cc.y+m*m*tg.y;
   ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=1-cl((m-.7)/.3);coin(x,y,q.r*(1-.5*m)*F.s,q.rot+lt*10);ctx.restore();});}
 // +1000
 if(t>7.7&&t<9.4){const k=bo(cl((t-7.7)/.5));const p=P(603,1670);ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=1-cl((t-9.0)/.4);ctx.translate(p.x,p.y);ctx.scale(k,k);
  ctx.font='800 170px "Baloo 2"';ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="middle";ctx.lineJoin="round";
  ctx.lineWidth=28;ctx.strokeStyle=C.prizeStroke;ctx.strokeText(CONFIG.prizeText,0,0);
  const gg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,-62,0,62);gg.addColorStop(0,C.prizeGoldLight);gg.addColorStop(.45,C.prizeText);gg.addColorStop(1,C.prizeGoldDark);
  ctx.fillStyle=gg;ctx.fillText(CONFIG.prizeText,0,0);ctx.restore();}
 // sparkles
 if(t>8.4){const r=rng(3);for(let i=0;i<16;i++){const hub=i<8?P(1006,136):P(603,1670);const ox=(r()-.5)*(i<8?300:620),oy=(r()-.5)*(i<8?150:150);if(i>=8&&t>9.4)continue;
  const a=Math.max(0,Math.sin((t-8.4)*4+r()*6));const sz=10+r()*14;ctx.save();ctx.translate(hub.x+ox,hub.y+oy);ctx.scale(a,a);ctx.fillStyle="#fff8c0";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-sz);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,0,sz,0);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,0,0,sz);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,0,-sz,0);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,0,0,-sz);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();}}
 // fade in
 if(t<.5){ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(0,0,0,${1-co(t/.5)})`;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);}
}
window.seek=async t=>{if(!ready)ready=init();await ready;draw(t);};
</script></body></html>

beats.text: Fade in, a glint across the title
The wheel spins and lands on the prize

presets.label: Land on 200 instead
presets.summary: The wheel now stops on 200 and the balance counts up to 400. Everything else is the same.

presets.label: More coins fly in
presets.summary: More than twice as many coins now fly into the balance, and they're larger. Nothing else moved.

presets.label: Green prize text
presets.summary: The prize number now pops in green with a dark green outline. Nothing else changed.
